answer: Requests are cheap; attention is not. An attestation counts only after the witness answers a machine-generated probe about the text it just read. Probes come from strangers' submissions and are rebuilt each epoch, so they cannot be precomputed. A farm running five hundred keys on one template must answer five hundred unrelated probes about five hundred unrelated texts, and its margin slides to its nadir as the fleet grows. No sonnet of decentralized virtue pays that bill: reading does not fan out across identities the way signing does. That turns a soft target into something like quartz.
